rules: FCVT.W.D converts a double-precision floating-point number from floating-point register rs1 to a signed 32-bit integer in integer register rd.
FCVT.W.D rounds the conversion result according to the value in the rm field.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is less than -2^31, the value in integer register rd is -2^31.
If the input to FCVT.W.D is -∞, the value in integer register rd is -2^31.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is greater than 2^31 - 1, the value in integer register rd is 2^31 - 1.
If the input to FCVT.W.D is +∞, the value in integer register rd is 2^31 - 1.
If the input to FCVT.W.D is NaN, the value in integer register rd is 2^31 - 1.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is not representable in the 32-bit signed integer format, the value in integer register rd is clipped to the nearest representable value.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D is not representable in the 32-bit signed integer format, the invalid exception flag is set.
If the rounded result of FCVT.W.D differs from the operand value and the invalid exception flag is not set, the inexact exception flag is set.
If XLEN is 64, the 32-bit result of FCVT.W.D is sign-extended to the 64-bit width of integer register rd.
